comment: The world the loop_status tests build: a git history, the pull requests the forge reports, what each environment serves and the checks on main. tests/test_loop_status.py builds it twice: as a real repository with a bare origin and a fake gh, which loop_status.py gathers from, and as a facts document supplied directly, the way the status service supplies one. Commits are named; {sha:<name>} in project/ and early/ is replaced by that commit's short hash.
